references.text: Complementary parts of the same narrative: verse 15 establishes the enemy's strength, which verse 34 attacks.
Strategic context: Verse 17 shows the total army, while verse 34 shows the selected force that carries out the decision.
Narrative contrast: Verse 25 shows Benjamin's temporary success, while verse 34 shows the final judgment.
Tactical development: Verse 20 is the general deployment, while verse 34 is the specific maneuver against Gibeah.
Narrative context: Verse 14 shows the start of the rebellion, while verse 34 shows its downfall.
Dramatic contrast: Verse 21 shows the enemy's strength, while verse 34 shows that this strength cannot save them from God's judgment.
Direct narrative link: Verse 34 describes the uncertainty before the disaster, while verse 41 describes the terror when the disaster strikes.
